  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint64_t fn_01(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint32_t h = 0xffffffff;\n  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    h ^= in[i];\n    for (uint32_t b = 0; b < 8; b++) {\n      h = -(h & 1) & 0xedb88320 ^ (h >> 1);\n    }\n  }\n  return (uint64_t)~h;\n}"
